error_budget.conclusion: Cross-axis command-model mismatch dominates diagnostic DR drift. Visual/posterior updates help overall (median RMSE .888->.420m) but do not consistently anchor translation; more than half of accepted-proposal frame updates worsen instantaneous XY error. They include sampling/best-particle changes and Manhattan, not pure deterministic CSM.
error_budget.caveats: Intervals use current command to next image (.2s); last6 commands without later GT excluded from motion count only. Sum local-frame displacements is not a global vector/path error. Counterfactuals are not closed-loop candidate performance, cannot separate friction slip from model/calibration defects without independent wheel measurements.

references.title: Campos et al., ORB-SLAM3, T-RO 2021
references.verified: paper full text and official README/System.h eSensor lines80-109
references.method: Continuous tracking, local bundle adjustment, covisibility/loop closure; mono and fisheye supported. Official sensor enum has no wheel-odometry interface.
references.fit: Usable own RGB foundation; metric scale unobservable for pure monocular, commands are uncertain priors not encoders. Wrist camera extrinsics must use own commanded arm FK and uncertainty; arm movement is not body motion.
references.changes_required: Command-motion factors/scale and state-dependent bias need an explicit adapter; not native ORB-SLAM3 functionality. GPLv3; no external code copied or library installed in this round.

references.title: Pumarola et al., PL-SLAM: Real-Time Monocular Visual SLAM with Points and Lines, ICRA 2017
references.method: Joint point/line reprojection BA, robust loss, point-line relocalization; line-only initialization needs five line matches over three views with small, continuous rotation.
references.fit: Wall edges/tape are candidates without pretending their upper edges lie on the floor. Repeated lines and pure rotation remain ambiguous. Existing Manhattan compass cannot constrain along-wall translation.
references.changes_required: The similarly named rubengooj/pl-slam official repo is STEREO and not a drop-in for this monocular rig; author monocular code availability/license not verified. No clone claimed.

references.title: Borenstein & Feng UMBmark; Censi et al. simultaneous odometry/sensor calibration
references.verified: UMBmark full IROS1995 primary paper; Censi author repository README and indexed author abstract; Censi full PDF retrieval failed, full equations unverified
references.method: Bidirectional systematic/non-systematic separation; maximum likelihood with independent exteroceptive relative motion and odometry.
references.fit: Raw yaw gains already .9996/1.0004; re-fit yaw alone is poorly targeted. Full planar pulse response including cross-axis mean/variance matters. Original differential-drive encoder closed form is not valid unchanged for mecanum issued commands.
references.changes_required: Estimate complete SE2 pulse bias using own visual relative motion in observable windows; do not fit to this GT audit, do not feed RBPF posterior back as independent calibration truth.

references.title: Hiwonder Glowing Ultrasonic Sensor; existing Thrun beam likelihood adapter
references.verified: official indexed product/wiki specification2-400cm,15deg; live page retrieval intermittent; repository beam model inspected. Noise .003+.01d is SIM assumption, not manufacturer accuracy.
references.method: Range hit/short/random/no-echo mixture; own walls and own sensor only. Ray target identity is not a permitted observation.
references.fit: Existing runs have sensor on but use it only for margin warnings, not localization. 10571/10719 valid readings<=.10m, medians.054-.055m; self-occlusion consistent but hit identities unavailable, so not proven. Reject self/held-load echoes by CAD visibility before fusion.
references.changes_required: Need usable external echoes and nonparallel wall geometry. A single range does not constrain tangent position/yaw, and no static-map goal is supplied.

primary_design.name: Continuous monocular local SLAM with joint pose/landmark optimization and a weak calibrated SE2 command prior
primary_design.status: design only, not adopted or implemented
architecture: Reuse actual ORB-SLAM3 tracking/local BA/loop machinery rather than the egomap68 isolated PnP bank; own images only.

Keep world gauge at own starting pose. Use commanded wrist FK with uncertainty; no live measured joint or GT inputs. Respect actual pinhole/fisheye calibration format rather than assuming every image is native fisheye.

Own issued pulses supply weak SE2/scale factors; estimate full cross-axis response bias from independent visual-motion windows, not from selected RBPF particles. Freeze bias learning in pure-rotation/low-parallax or repeated-pattern ambiguity.

Jointly optimize stored B landmarks and traversed route with keyframes so pose corrections do not leave old targets in inconsistent coordinates; occupancy map remains the frozen egomap34 mapping backend.

Preserve .20m and five fresh-frame arrival verification and report loss rather than unconditional homing success. False pickup-floor B and arrival deadlock remain separate blockers. No success-rate uplift is asserted.

numeric_basis.interpretation: 0.888->0.154m (82.7% reduction) is same-command GT-component diagnostic headroom, not a deployable correction or expected measured performance. No quantitative success prediction is justified.

primary_design.next_check: First validate independent visual relative motion and cross-axis consistency on held-out own RGB segments, with GT evaluation only. Then one minimal 5.5m closed-loop carry cohort; current data cannot certify loaded E2E.

alternative_design.name: Structural point/line SLAM plus own ultrasonic range factors
alternative_design.status: conditional alternative; current sensor data unsuitable for direct localization
alternative_design.numeric_basis: Valid readings10719/13611 but10571/10719 (98.62%) <=.10m; at most148/13611 (1.09%) longer readings, some may be outliers. Thus current data do not support predicted localization improvement. SIM noise only: sigma13mm at1m,43mm at4m, before association/pose errors.
alternative_design.mechanism: Temporal line associations and point-line BA supply angular/structural constraints; independent, unobstructed range to own observed lines supplies metric normal-distance. Two nonparallel surfaces are needed for planar position observability.
alternative_design.limitations: Self arm/load visibility must be checked and physical transducer/beam accuracy verified. No GT hit names, no static targets; environment changes remain a user decision.
